description: stack-guard hooks: the secret guard hides secret values that show up in tool output and checks the final reply; the update check says when a newer stack-guard is out.

hooks.command: PY=python3; [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ] && PY=python; command -v "$PY" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/update_check.py" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SolanceLab/stack-guard/main/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json solancelab || true
